rule: This file declares the one R31 deliverable and its layers. The ZIP itself is produced only by .github/workflows/r31-verification.yml (artifact_receipt job, artifact 'r31-verification-receipt', folder delivery/) from the real APK built in the same run; tools/r31/package_release.py refuses an APK whose bytes, identity or signature differ from that build. PENDING_CI fields are filled from that run's receipt, never by hand-written values.

apk.variant: release when the sealed R13 key opens in CI, otherwise debug labelled DEBUG-NOT-OFFICIAL

signing: PENDING_CI: official only if scripts/load_r13_signing.py opens .github/r13-signing.sealed.json in that run; the transport private key is not in this repository, so NOT_OFFICIAL is expected and is written as such
